incremental_second_review.raster_comparison: Compared every r6/r7 page at 0.7x. Exactly 25 pages changed: p1 for all 20 lessons plus L04 p2-p3 and L09 p2-p4; the other 92 pages are pixel-identical at the comparison scale.
incremental_second_review.title_verification: All 20 first-page PDF title strings exactly match generated DOCX title paragraphs after whitespace normalization; all title strips visually reviewed.

page_count_comparison.comparison_basis: Same Content 2.4 bytes for all runs. The historical 133-page r4 output was rendered under the default environment; controlled 1.1.2/1.1.3/1.1.4 comparison reruns used the same temporary CJK Fontconfig alias. Page count is not treated as a quality score.
page_count_comparison.comparison_observation: Across the representative long-remark pages L01 p3, L06 p3 and L18 p3, v1.1.2 wraps remarks into narrow vertical stacks; v1.1.3 improves horizontal room; optional v1.1.4 preserves horizontal reading while fixing lesson-table continuation layout. v1.1.3 improves long-note readability on the sampled pages but still leaves L12/L19 sparse tails versus v1.1.4.
